title: She Left GameSpot After 12 Years to Start a Secret Game-Finding Club!
summary:
Have you ever scrolled through endless game lists, not knowing what to try next? Lucy James felt the same way — and she worked at GameSpot for 12 years! Now she’s doing something about it. She left her job to start a weekly newsletter called lookingfor.game. Every week, she’ll tell you about exciting new PC games and even send demo codes straight to your inbox. That means you can try games for free before anyone else!

But Lucy isn’t doing this alone. She’s teaming up with Geoff Keighley, the famous host of Summer Game Fest, and a new platform called Player.gg. Think of Player.gg as a super-smart helper that tracks new game announcements, recommends games you might love, and organizes your Steam wishlist. It’s like a personal game-finding robot!

Lucy said GameSpot was a special place, but she wanted to focus on indie games — those smaller, creative games made by tiny teams. “I’m excited to build a community and start sharing awesome games,” she said. Player.gg will even let her partner with game studios to offer exclusive beta invites. So if you love discovering hidden gem games, Lucy’s newsletter might just become your new best friend.
why_it_matters: If you love playing PC games, this newsletter could help you discover exciting new games for free, making your hobby even more fun.
